description: Ministry of Skills Development, Employmant and Labour Relations - Collective Agreement entered into between Pradeshiya Sanwardhana Bank and the Ceylon Bank Employees Union and 03 Other Collective Agreements
categorisation: This gazette content publishes a Collective Agreement between a bank and a union under the Industrial Disputes Act. It contains detailed regulatory provisions about employment terms, salary structures, allowances, and working conditions. This falls under Legal/Regulatory matters as it involves the formal publication of a legally binding agreement that establishes regulatory frameworks and compliance requirements for employment relations.
